purpose: Catalog of supplier, marketplace, and API routes for AutoStop procurement price and availability checks.
principles: Красноярск stock and pickup first; Siberia and Russia-wide order second.
Use official API, contracted price list export, supplier cabinet, phone confirmation, or public marketplace pages only.
Do not scrape closed supplier cabinets unless the supplier explicitly permits it.
Separate закупочная цена, public retail, client sale price, package price, and repair-order line total.
Store evidence fields with every quote so the agent can re-check quickly later.

sources.name: ROSSKO / Росско
sources.api_status: api_keys_available_for_registered_account; confirm official terms with ROSSKO manager
sources.verification: Use as a high-priority Krasnoyarsk source after AutoStop account/API keys are available. Confirm warehouse, pickup address, price type, and return terms before writing закупка.

sources.name: ARMTEK / Армтек
sources.verification: Treat as B2B supplier route. Use only account-approved API/ETP or exported price lists; confirm Krasnoyarsk logistics.

sources.name: Autopiter / Автопитер
sources.verification: Use for Russia-wide закупка and supplier comparison; оптовые цены require legal-entity registration/account.

sources.name: AutoEuro API / АвтоЕвро
sources.verification: API can confirm price, stock, delivery, create orders, and check order status after API activation in the client account.

sources.name: ZZap
sources.verification: Use public search as price benchmark and seller comparison; API route requires partner approval and should not replace supplier-confirmed закупка.

sources.name: PARTSAPI.RU
sources.verification: Use for fitment, TecDoc-style crosses, VIN/frame/OEM routing, not as a procurement price source unless a price endpoint is explicitly confirmed.

sources.name: UMAPI
sources.verification: Evaluate for supplier price-list exchange and catalog enrichment; do not assume it provides Красноярск stock without connected suppliers.

sources.name: Autopiter Webservice Docs
sources.api_status: public docs visible; supplier account required for live use
sources.verification: Use docs for implementation planning; live price/order calls need real account credentials.

sources.name: Mikado Webservice
sources.verification: Use as an additional API candidate after commercial access is confirmed.

sources.name: AutoSputnik / Автоспутник API
sources.api_status: public legacy API docs; new API migration noted by supplier
sources.verification: Use only after supplier login and current API endpoint are confirmed; legacy docs mention migration and shutdown timing.

sources.name: APEC API
sources.verification: Use as import/Russia-order benchmark if commercial account and delivery route are relevant to AutoStop.

sources.name: AUTOPOISK

sources.verification: Use for professional catalog/cross/OEM enrichment and supplier-market context; not a direct закупка source until connected supplier prices are verified.

sources.name: Exist
sources.api_status: not_confirmed_for_autostop; treat as cabinet/manual until contract exists
sources.verification: Use VIN/catalog route first, then exact article price and delivery check.

sources.name: Autodoc

sources.name: Liqui Moly Красноярск
sources.verification: Use as local fluids benchmark only when OEM approval/spec and package size are clear.

sources.name: Drom Parts Красноярск
sources.verification: Use exact OEM and vehicle/model queries; verify city, photos, seller, warranty, and whether price is for one item or a set.

sources.name: Avito Parts Красноярск

integration_backlog.task: Collect AutoStop supplier accounts and contacts for ROSSKO, ARMTEK, Autopiter, AutoEuro, Emex, Exist, Autodoc, and local Krasnoyarsk suppliers.
integration_backlog.done_when: For each supplier, account status, city, price type, API/export availability, and manager contact are recorded outside Git in private settings.

integration_backlog.task: Request API keys or price-list exports where allowed.
integration_backlog.done_when: Credentials are stored in environment variables or a private secrets store, never in docs or repo.

integration_backlog.task: Implement a read-only quote normalizer that maps every supplier response to normalized_quote_fields.
integration_backlog.done_when: One query returns comparable offers with source, stock, lead time, package, закупка, and confidence.

integration_backlog.task: Add cache with timestamp and source quote id.
integration_backlog.done_when: The agent can reuse fresh quotes but knows when price must be rechecked.

integration_backlog.task: Allow order creation only after manual owner approval.
integration_backlog.done_when: No API integration can place paid supplier orders silently.
